name: gamegen
description: Create 2D, 2.5D and 3D games with shared project preferences, concept art, Blender, Godot and measured validation.

interface.shortDescription: From game idea to a tested playable build.
interface.longDescription: Fifteen coordinated game-production skills with question-driven setup, reusable project preferences, concept references, 2D and 3D asset workflows, procedural music and sound effects, and optional SpriteCook or Higgsfield integrations.
defaultPrompt: Start a new game with GameGen.
Resume this game using its saved GameGen preferences.
